U.note: Clean iOS-style dark calculator with history line and clear divide-by-zero message, but few aria hooks and the % key is extra.

V.note: Beautiful skeuomorphic LCD with Error state, but it is overbuilt (branding, indicators, shortcut footer, CE plus backspace) and the long source pads a basic calculator.

W.note: Compact retro pocket calculator with seven-segment display, wide equals and good semantics; a bit decorative, truncates to 8 digits.

X.note: Light, high-contrast and legible with a red divide-by-zero message, thousands grouping, auto-shrinking display, solid aria and keyboard support.

Y.note: Solid dark layout with strong orange operators and Error state, but the long 20-nine display is tiny and 0 label is left-aligned oddly.

Z.note: Minimal dark theme with a restrained blue accent, history line, Error in red, 12-digit cap, good roles and keyboard handling.
